body:
Real, live follow-up to the earlier 10v10/branding fix (Apple #16419):
founder reported the client now correctly says ECOWAR and connects,
but gets "failed to join match, does not launch."

Root cause, confirmed directly in the matchmaker's own log: the arena
server it spawned printed "WARNING: REDGARDEN_TICKET_SECRET not set --
all connect attempts will be rejected (fail closed, not fail open)" --
I had started the matchmaker as a bare background process earlier
(for immediate testing) without exporting that env var, so every real
connect ticket the client presented was rejected even though
matchmaking itself succeeded (a real player DID get matched -- the log
shows "MATCHMAKER: matched 2 players -> spawned server on port 9600"
-- but the spawned server then rejected the join).

Fixed by restarting matchmaker+bot-pool with REDGARDEN_TICKET_SECRET
set (same test value PLAY.bat already sets client-side). Verified: the
matchmaker's own log now shows "REDGARDEN_TICKET_SECRET loaded (34
bytes)" and a real "CLIENT 0 CONNECTED (owner 0, 1/2)" -- an actual
connection succeeded this time. Currently 1 matchmaker + 1 bot running
clean on :9779, bot queued (1/2), waiting for a real second player.

Real, honest limitation found along the way: attempted to deploy the
real, already-correctly-configured systemd units (ops/systemd/
ecowar-matchmaker.service already has REDGARDEN_TICKET_SECRET baked
in) via `systemctl --user`, but this sandbox has no user D-Bus session
("Failed to connect to bus: Permission denied") -- systemd deployment
isn't possible from here. Fell back to a manually-started background
process instead, which is real and working right now but will NOT
survive a reboot or this session ending -- the real systemd deploy
still needs to happen from a session that actually has a user login
bus (or via sudo-queue for a system-level unit instead), a real,
separate follow-up.

session: sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e

⚓ ☃
title: Fixed real 'failed to join match' -- REDGARDEN_TICKET_SECRET wasn't set on the manually-started matchmaker
